convergence.exportInvocation: pen interactive --in <file.pen> --out <file.pen>; execute({ input: 'Export(["<frameId>", ...], "png", "<dir>")' }) — default scale 2; the .pen MUST sit at its committed lane path so the relative library import resolves. Re-export verified byte-deterministic across three consecutive runs (identical sha256 per frame).
convergence.comparison: pixelmatch threshold 0.1 (harness convention), per-state budget 1.0% (dispatch default; contract pixelThreshold 0.03 is the Gate-1 story-vs-pen budget, not this loop's). Targets = NORMALIZED prototype, contract root #cs-buttons .ui-spec, contract preShot (caption + hidden-native-select strip) plus an integer-origin snap (pure translate — Playwright element screenshots round outward from fractional page coords; tooling alignment, not a layout edit). Chromium 151.0.7922.34 (playwright 1.62.1), deviceScaleFactor 2, capture protocol v2.1 (freeze CSS, fonts ready, pointer parking, geometry quiescence, self-consistency gate), network fully blocked, Heebo rendered from the same TTF the .pen references (pencil/designs/fonts/Heebo-VariableFont_wght.ttf, installed into fontconfig).
convergence.iterationNotes: Iter 1 (authored from measured normalized-render geometry, no baseline compensation): 0.85-1.05% — three states marginally over budget; offset probes localized 1-device-px text line-box rounding on the field label and body cells. Iter 2 (half-pixel compensation, sign inverted by mistake): all worse, 1.12-1.63% — kept only as the probe that proved pen does NOT quantize sub-pixel text y. Iter 3 (corrected signs: label -0.5, body cells +0.5): all pass, 0.65-0.93%. Iter 4 (per-row-class rule, measured: body-cell glyph runs align when their table-relative line-box y is integer — snap half-pixel rows up, leave integer rows; label keeps -0.5): 0.59-0.69%. Residual is cross-rasterizer text antialiasing — Chromium stem-darkens small text (label strip ink 31.9 vs pen 22.2 at 11px/500) while glyph advances and positions align to <=1 device px; 13-14px text ink ratios 1.01-1.07. menu-open and menu-open-option-focus differ only in the focused option's wash, as contracted.
convergence.geometryProbesDetail: All contract computed-style probes reproduced on the normalized render and carried into the frames verbatim: root-stack flex column / 6px gap / flex-start; field-label 11px/500/uppercase/0.55px; trigger 180x36 with the closed 1px + pad 8/12 vs open 2px accent + pad 7/11 switch (box never shifts); chevron 16x16, flip matrix(-1, 0, 0, -1, 0, 0) open (frames use lucide chevron-down/chevron-up — identical geometry to the 180deg rotation); menu block/absolute/min-width 100%/max-height 280px/6px radius/4px pad/z-index 60 (rendered 180x121 at Heebo metrics; the contract's 180x115 was measured on the fallback stack); option rows flex/8px gap/8-12 pad/4px radius/14px/left; selected option weight 500; table 300px/max-width 100%/separate 0/13px/1px border/8px radius + overflow clip/10px top margin; header cells left/600/9-12 pad/1px underline; visible row cells 9-12 pad/1px rule; last DOM row drops its rule (R13). Text vectors V3 verbatim in every state.

tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: #171717 has no Hemlock role; the library's own Select binds its value text and option text to sem-text-header (#0E0E0E light). Role-first, small visual darkening.
The label's own declared fallback IS --muted (#5E5954 = sem-text-meta light); caption-scale secondary text is the meta role.

Secondary-icon role at the same resolved value as sem-text-meta, preserving the prototype's label/chevron shared-variable coupling. DELIBERATE divergence from the library Select's chevron binding ($sem-icons-subtle #8A8680) — designer may prefer re-binding to the library convention.
The library Select/open Dropdown border binds sem-borders-dark; Bill's neutral #E5E5E5 has no role. Warm taupe replaces neutral gray, matching the trigger border.
Popovers are elevated surfaces (library Select Dropdown convention). Same light value as sem-background-surface; diverges correctly in dark (navy-600 vs navy-700).

shadow-md IS the system's dropdown elevation (y 4 / blur 12 exact; alpha 12% -> 10.2%). NOTE a library/skill naming drift: the skill doc names shadow colors unprefixed (shadow-md-color); hemlock-library.lib.pen implements $prim-shadow-md-color and its own components bind it directly — bound the library's actual token.

The prototype drives the option wash and this underline from ONE variable; sem-background-highlight owns that accent-subtle role. Drawn as a 1px rectangle; binding the same token avoids minting a near-duplicate border token.
The system's 1.5 ratio token, bound uniformly. Divergence from the scale's per-size pairings (sm pairs with 1.4286) is a convention question for the designer, not a new token.
